ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: I selected Dunlin because this is a clear-cut arithmetic/expected-value problem with a single correct answer, and Dunlin holds a modest edge on the quantitative benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.9, GPQA 64.1 vs 56.2) that best proxy this kind of reasoning. The query has clear completion criteria, which would also suit Willet's stated preferences, but since capability is what matters for getting the arithmetic right, the benchmark edge was the deciding factor.
